videoDetails.title: 2026 Overtures Roundtable Part 2
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Derek Radney, Steve Tipton, David Coffin, and Howie Donahoe join for round two of a roundtable discussion exploring the overtures and key questions facing the PCA ahead of the 2026 General Assembly. In Part 2, the panel discusses women as deacons, the Danvers Statement, the Lord’s Supper, among other topics.

Overtures Discussion Part 1: https://youtu.be/xezEYJN8aiM
Overtures Discussion Part 3: https://youtu.be/cxQxeng9eow
